description: DB server scan: Oracle DBMS only, run INSIDE the Oracle container via docker exec (host has no sqlplus). Uses in-container OS auth (/ as sysdba) so no password is needed. Uploads CSV to S3 results/. Infra is excluded (the DB host's file-walk is too heavy).

S3Base.description: S3 base prefix (tools/ and results/ live under it).

Container.description: Name of the running Oracle Docker container on the DB host.

runCommand: if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[!] aws CLI not available on this host'; exit 1; fi
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[!] docker not found on this host'; exit 1; fi
if [ -z "$(docker ps -q -f name={{Container}})" ]; then echo '[!] container {{Container}} is not running'; exit 1; fi
aws s3 cp {{S3Base}}/tools/db_oracle_check.sh db_oracle_check.sh || { echo '[!] download db_oracle_check failed'; exit 1; }
echo '[*] oracle scan inside container {{Container}} (OS auth / as sysdba)...'
timeout 300 docker exec -i {{Container}} bash -s -- --csv /tmp/dbout.csv < db_oracle_check.sh; echo "[*] oracle rc=$? (124=timeout, else ignore)"
docker cp {{Container}}:/tmp/dbout.csv "$OUT" || { echo '[!] no CSV produced inside container (scan failed - check container/Oracle)'; exit 1; }
aws s3 cp scan/ {{S3Base}}/results/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' || { echo '[!] S3 upload failed - check IAM s3:PutObject'; exit 1; }
